r24.summary: An unsigned slip headed Brussels 9 Oct 1721, probably from the internuncio at Brussels (Austrian Netherlands) to the nuncio at Cologne: news wanted of a suspended parish priest and of a person at Tournai, the Cologne affair, and an offer to write to a correspondent of the recipient, awaiting orders.
r24.en:
Heading in clear: Brussels, 9 October 1721.

About the curate [45] [9441] [43]te divinis, [?grateful] to know something of [9336] [9485] of Tournai. About the
affair of Cologne; but he, from what I see, is informed of it. If you think it fitting that I [76] write in [9356] to a
correspondent of yours, I shall do it gladly, but I await your orders on this.

snip.cap: Arch. Nunz. Colonia 5 f. 26r: headed Brusselles 9 ott.re 1721, nine lines of comma-separated figures

system: Comma-separated homophones of 1-3 digits for letters and syllables, nulls 2/22/222 as spacers, 4-digit nomenclator codes 93xx-94xx (Lasry key ASV-C15).
